Discharge Summary

Admission date/time: 17:13 on 04/03/2020
Discharge date/time: 02:41 on 22/03/2020

Diagnosis: COVID-19 pneumonia, confirmed by SARS-CoV-2 PCR (swab taken 21:56 on 04/03/2020), positive result reported 23:53 on 04/03/2020.

Presenting complaint: Fever, cough and breathlessness with hypoxia (SpO2 <92% on air recorded 10:06 on 04/03/2020).

Hospital course: Admitted to the acute medical unit for oxygen therapy and monitoring.
Enoxaparin thromboprophylaxis commenced on admission, first dose given 21:28 on 04/03/2020, continued throughout without complication. Oxygen requirement peaked at 3L via nasal cannula during the first week with subsequent gradual improvement. Remained ward-based throughout and did not require critical care input, though this had initially been discussed given the severity of presentation. The prolonged admission reflected slow resolution of fatigue and oxygen requirement rather than any acute deterioration. Physiotherapy input provided for reconditioning prior to discharge.

Medications on discharge: Enoxaparin continued as required for residual myalgia.
Paracetamol continued as required for residual myalgia.

Follow-up arrangements: Respiratory clinic review arranged within 2 weeks of discharge to assess recovery and consider further investigation if symptoms persist.

GP actions: Please monitor ongoing recovery, review for any residual breathlessness or fatigue, and advise gradual return to normal activity.
